subject: Oceanography
title: Illegal Fishing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Illegal Fishing usable.

hook.text: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing steals $23 billion worth of fish each year.

buildup.text: IUU vessels turn off tracking systems, fish in protected areas, and use banned methods like dynamite.

discovery.text: Satellite monitoring and AI now track 'dark vessels'—ships that disappear from radar in suspicious patterns.

twist.text: IUU fishing is linked to human trafficking—crews are trapped on boats for years in forced labor conditions.

climax.text: Developing nations lose the most—their waters are poached while they lack the navies to enforce boundaries.

punchline.text: Pirate fishing robs the ocean and the poorest nations alike.

quiz.question: How much does IUU fishing cost globally each year?
